summary: Animated UI part widget: binds named nw::lyt panes (null_shadow/null_panel/atari), drives the layout animation state machine (normal/base/opened/seal/disabled), and caches the hit rectangle plus the registered field-object handles.
evidence: Ui_Part_SetupFromAnimRecord(0x001B9030) binds pane names null_shadow_l/null_panel_l/null_panel_l_lw/atari_txt and stores them at +0x50/+0x54/+0x58; Ui_Part_UpdateAnimState(0x001B8764) compares/sets the anim state at +0xA4 using the anim table at +0x60 and record id at +0x4A; Ui_Part_Ctor(0x00448EE0) initialises +0x45/+0x46/+0x47. Several subclasses share this offset range with different meanings, hence the low class confidence.

summary: Orbit-camera/model-view rig for the status screen and field model preview: holds the selected model id, a scale triple, an eye-distance/azimuth camera pose and four embedded point-path curves for the character model; updated per frame by Ui_ModelView_UpdateModelRotation.
evidence: Ui_ModelView_SetSelectedCharacter(0x002AE7E4)/SetCharacterText(0x00599B10) store the selected id at +0x80 (record+0x14/+0xC) and the scale triple at +0x74; UpdateModelRotation(0x0059AB54) builds an orbiting eye offset from +0x48/+0x4C and calls Camera_SetTransitionTarget with +0x50/+0x5C; four 0x28-byte path containers at +0x15C/+0x184/+0x1AC/+0x1D4 are built by ComposeCharacterText(0x0059A604) via Path_BuildFromPoints. The sibling class Camera_Field (same 508-byte layout, vtable 0x77E258) confirms the +0xE0 embedded block and the four paths.
